AVS - Patient Instructions
Northgate Urgent Care

Patient: Devon Park   Date of service: 01/22/2026
Provider: Sandra Lee, PA-C

Diagnosis: acute bronchitis

Stop taking the over-the-counter cough syrup.
Start benzonatate 100 mg three times daily as needed for cough.
Order chest X-ray today before leaving the clinic.

Schedule a visit with your PCP within 2 weeks.

Return to the emergency department if you have trouble breathing, coughing up blood, or a fever above 102 F.
